How to write an encounter account

This public copy explains how to write the encounter account in a situated Yinyang package. That account gives a returning counterpart a usable understanding of this collaboration: what the person is trying to do, how the participants contribute, what their work meets in the world, and what remains open to correction. The entrypoint owns initial reading for full adoption. Reading the philosophy or borrowing a useful method does not require creating these five accounts or adopting the author's developmental purpose.

Make the collaboration intelligible as a whole

An encounter account selects what matters across the other accounts. Its value is the connection: why a person's purpose calls for this counterpart's contribution, how the environment enables that contribution, and what a successful result would mean here. A list of preferences cannot supply that connection. Nor can literary description that leaves the counterpart unable to decide how to work.

Begin with a real activity or continuing purpose for which shared understanding would help. Relevant material may include the person's account of a difficulty, corrections during work, a chosen way of participating, and results that exposed a mistaken assumption. Develop their connections using the guidance for building a user model, describing the counterpart and relationship, and describing situated use; the guide to organizing sources and grounds helps distinguish their support. Develop a missing connection through design and revision without disguising uncertainty as a settled portrait.

The prose should let a counterpart understand the stakes without reconstructing the whole history. Explain what the person seeks and why the arrangement helps; what they want to contribute themselves; what the model is expected and actually able to carry; and where external conditions or unavailable experience matters. Describe development when it is this person's purpose. Useful collaboration can also serve a bounded task, an informed choice, or room to explore.

Condense without erasing differences

Actual expression, interpretation, and chosen commitment can lead to different actions. A person may report that repeated technical questions interrupt their thinking. The model may interpret this as a need for continuity. The participants may choose to have the model investigate implementation details while making consequential choices intelligible. These are connected contributions with different grounds; none establishes that the person dislikes every question or cannot judge technical work.

For a deliberately fictional illustration, “ask fewer questions” during a configuration task could concern avoidable detail questions. An account might explain that the person wants to remain with the larger problem while the model carries investigation and implementation. It would leave room for a question about unavailable personal purpose. If the actual reason was simply that a suitable tool already answered the question, a lasting preference account would overstate the evidence. The illustration shows a distinction to examine, not a person to copy into the situated files.

Literary or philosophical language can gather these relations when the participants find it useful. Explain the consequences giving an image its situated meaning. Sun and Moon do not tell a new adopter who they are; a coherent philosophy does not establish personal facts. Plain prose can carry practical understanding too.

Keep a usable entrance current

Retain the detail that changes ordinary understanding or action here. Extended episodes and precise attribution stay with their existing private owners; link to deeper accounts rather than reproducing them. Concision works because those connections remain available, not because their reasons have been discarded.

Revise when purposes, participation, capabilities, or conditions materially change, or work contradicts the picture. Return a mistaken inference to its owning account; repair environmental mismatch through harness adaptation. Read the revised whole for what a counterpart would understand and do differently. Reading shows availability; collaboration supplies evidence of fit. Common updates preserve the situated account's supported substance rather than replacing it with this guidance.
